name: TabFact: Large-Scale Dataset for Table-based Fact Verification
description: TabFact is a large-scale fact verification benchmark over structured data consisting of 117,854 filtered human-annotated natural language statements (118,275 raw collected) grounded on 16,573 Wikipedia tables. Each statement is labeled as either Entailed or Refuted, challenging models with table reasoning, cell lookup, and arithmetic aggregation.
